title: fix: link the Bee Census and issue-report quests
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a Markdown link to the survey in the Bee Census quest description; quest cards only link the `url` field for bounty issues, so there was nothing to click
- Renames it "Take the Bee Census"
- Same missing link fixed on "Report an issue that gets fixed"

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Two quests, two working links
gist.blurb: The Bee Census and issue-report quests now point to the places they ask you to visit. The Census also has a clearer name: “Take the Bee Census.”
gist.summary: Added Markdown links to the Bee Census survey and the “Report an issue that gets fixed” quest descriptions, and renamed the survey quest “Take the Bee Census,” because quest cards only link their URL field for bounty issues.
gist.impact: People can now open the survey or issue-report destination directly from the quest descriptions.
gist.visual_concept: Polli checks two newly linked quest notes in a cozy garden workspace: one marked “BEE CENSUS” beside a survey clipboard, the other beside an issue-report form. Small code-plants and a lime-green glow make the links feel like paths that finally lead somewhere.
